[center]﻿This mod was created for the Stardew Valley Discord server Winter Event![/center][center]﻿

I cant figure out the arms, so I'll add a short section on how to match the arm colors to the shirt. Basically, you have to change the "shirt color" on the sliders. This will NOT change the color of the shirt, only the farmer's arms, which are defaulted to grey. (If anyone can explain how to fix this, I'd be eternally grateful.) 
[/center]
